abstract: Maintains production lot isolation procedures and robotic cassette transfer lock records
system_message:
You are the Semiconductor manufacturing operations lead (OPS), responsible for maintaining production lot isolation procedures and robotic cassette transfer lock records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: United States·Maintains production lot isolation procedures and robotic cassette transfer lock records（ISOL）
information_points.content:
OPS-ISOL-F5F：For United States facilities, the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol demonstrates that wafer bay isolation readiness is true across scanner and track tool load-ports.
OPS-ISOL-EJC：For facilities in the United States, audit records confirm that wafer bay isolation readiness is true for the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol across active lot load-ports.
OPS-ISOL-793：Under United States operations, wafer bay isolation readiness is false for the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol based on load-port isolation audit logs.

information_points.title: Japan·Maintains production lot isolation procedures and robotic cassette transfer lock records（WIP）
information_points.content:
OPS-WIP-X3B：For facilities located in Japan, wafer bay isolation readiness is false for the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol according to tool interface audits.
OPS-WIP-6JS：Within Japan facilities, the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol maintains that wafer bay isolation readiness is true.
OPS-WIP-7WM：Regarding facility operations in Japan, audit records indicate that wafer bay isolation readiness is false for the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol.
